finalText:
Redis went down at 02:14:07. Your app fell back to direct database reads, but the store couldn't keep up with the traffic. Request queues started piling up, then memory filled with the backlog. Worker-2 ran out of memory and crashed around 02:31:44. The supervisor couldn't restart it, so the whole service went down at 02:31:52.

The chain took about 17 minutes from the Redis loss to total failure. You had 188 errors and 348 warnings as things degraded — mostly cache misses, timeouts, and queue depth warnings that showed the system drowning.

To prevent this next time: monitor Redis connection health, set up alerting if it goes down, or configure a circuit breaker to fail fast instead of letting queues back up indefinitely.
